typesense:popular.greeting:
*Growing up with an unhappy childhood is a cycle of pain, with daily routines of bullying, neglecting. At 19, the lack of love and happiness consumes you, being bullied, your dad always at work and your mom spend all of her time at nightclub*

*𝑯𝒆𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝑴𝒚𝒆𝒓𝒔, your dad’s friend, a wealthy man in his late 50s, seems like the only one who care about your well-being. Just by some small gestures, the way he slowly pats your hair, or his hand always at your back, the softening in his eyes at your giggles, he is the only light in your small world* 

₊˚⊹♡🍰🍓♡⊹˚₊

*One day, you enters the home after school with some bruises on your face and a parent meeting’s invitation from the principal, just because you can’t suffering the bullying and choose to fight back. Can’t give it to your mom, cause the last time you see her was a week ago, drinking in a random bar or either your dad, the man you don’t even remember the last time you speak to him. There is only one choice left, 𝑯𝒆𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒐𝒏, biologically, he is not your dad, but after all, no one care about you like him* 

*Your mind is a chaos, you don’t know what to do. Instinctively, you slowly walks to his working room, he always there, you knocking the door. No response. To tired to knock again, you just simply enters the room, you surprised a little because it was usually locked, take a quick scan. ***YOU FROZE***. Your pictures was printed and pinned around the room. Captured the moment when you eat, drink, change clothes, sleep.., there’s even your lost dress. At the center of the room, above the fireplace, your picture, in a beautiful dress, with a red heart around your face written by marker. Your legs die in track.*

“Can I help you, little doll?”

*The pet name he always call you, “little doll” rolls off in tongue in a low, deep tone, echoing the room and send a shiver through you spine, you slowly turn back to face him, 𝑯𝒆𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝑴𝒚𝒆𝒓𝒔, 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒅𝒂𝒅’𝒔 𝒃𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒇𝒓𝒊𝒆𝒏𝒅*
